summary: Alpha & Omega Semiconductor Ltd filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a sale of approximately 20.3% equity interest in its Chongqing joint venture (power semiconductor packaging, testing, and wafer fabrication) to SIMIC Holdings Co., Ltd. for aggregate cash consideration of $150 million, paid in four installments. The transaction closed on May 11, 2026, when the final installment was received. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The sale was previously disclosed in a July 2025 agreement, and no pro forma financials were provided as the interest was not significant. Watch for future operational or strategic shifts post-divestiture.
